description: Open a motion playground at a local link where the designer can tune it in their browser and use Send to your agent to send you a note along with the motion as they tuned it. Pass the html_path that create_motion_playground returned. Hand the designer the url, not the file path: the file opened on its own cannot send. Then call get_motion_sends to receive what they send. This is separate from Raven Grab and puts nothing on top of the page. The link works on this computer only, for as long as this Raven process runs, and the file is read fresh on every load, so a rebuilt playground shows up when the designer reloads.

html_path.description: Absolute path to the playground's .html file, usually the html_path from create_motion_playground. Must be a regular file, not a symlink, at most 8 MB.

name: open_motion_playground
